lemma: Embedding lemma (reproduces owner paper Thm 4.1; NOT new; closes no obligation). Setting: K subset F^I a subspace, I = disjoint union of I_v over v in V(G), G finite, d >= 1. Hypotheses: (R) rank pi_X >= d|X| for all X subset V; (L) z,z' in K with z|_v != 0 != z'|_v imply supp z meets supp z'; (E) uv in E(G), z|_u != 0, z'|_v != 0 imply supp z meets supp z'. Claim: for every finite spanning family B = (b_1..b_k) of K there is an injection phi: V x [d] -> {1..k} with phi(v,i) in S_v := {j : b_j|_v != 0}, such that every edge of G[K_d] (lexicographic product: (u,i)~(v,j) iff uv in E or (u=v, i != j)) maps to an edge of H_B (j ~ k iff supports meet). Proof: For Y subset V x [d] with projection X, N(Y) = union_{v in X} S_v = {j : pi_X(b_j) != 0}. Since B spans K, the vectors pi_X(b_j) span pi_X(K), which has dimension >= d|X| by (R); hence at least d|X| of them are nonzero, so |N(Y)| >= d|X| >= |Y|. Hall's theorem gives phi. Inside a block, phi(v,i) != phi(v,i') both lie in S_v, so (L) gives adjacency. Across an edge uv, phi(u,i) in S_u and phi(v,j) in S_v, so (E) gives adjacency. Hence phi embeds G[K_d] in H_B, and tw(H_B) >= tw(G[K_d]) by subgraph monotonicity of treewidth. Verified by hand; finite consistency check cm-b7a548c7f69944ab (7 graphs, 49 families over GF(3)) agrees but is not a proof input.
